screens.title: Natally · Souvenir PDF Three-Page Grimoire Folio

outputComponents.text:
I have designed and delivered the three-page Natally souvenir PDF spread (`Natally · Souvenir PDF Three-Page Grimoire Folio`) adhering strictly to the Natally design system and your exact content specifications:

### Design Highlights:
1. **Atelier Aesthetics & Typography**:
   - **Color Palette**: Dark plum-black background (`#120c1c`), warm cream text (`#f1e8d8`), antique gold accents (`#c9a24a` and `#f2ca50`), deep purple panels (`#1a1226` and `#2a1d3d`), and subtle plum borders (`#3a2d50`).
   - **Type Hierarchy**: Display serif headings in **Fraunces**, uppercase section labels and chapter markers in **Cinzel**, and body copy in **Nunito Sans**.
   - **Print Margins & Whitespace**: Generous spacing formatted into three side-by-side US-Letter portrait print folios with delicate antique corner brackets.

2. **Spread Structure & Exact Content**:
   - **Page 1 (Dark Folio)**: Chapter cover **"CHAPTER FOUR · Houses"** anchored by a crisp, handcrafted gold chart wheel line drawing showing the celestial houses, cardinal axes (ASC/DSC/MC/IC), and concentric astronomical rings.
   - **Page 2 (Dark Folio)**: Element cover **"HOUSES · VII · The Seventh House — Partners, agreements, and the people who stand opposite you"**, complete with an illuminated wheel diagram highlighting the 7th house segment, followed by the gold-bordered panel **"You and this house"** detailing:
     - Begins at Descendant: `28° 09′ Taurus`
     - Planets here: `Moon (02° 51′ Taurus)`
     - Ruler: `Venus in Libra`
     - A line from your reading: *"Trust your sovereign impulses over external consensus. With Taurus Moon anchoring the bodily instincts in your 6th house, take heed of bodily fatigue before signing covenants."*
   - **Page 3 (Light Cream Folio)**: Deep dive **"The setting place"** set in rich parchment cream (`#f7f2ea`) with disciplined grimoire typography across four distinct sections:
     - **Origins**
     - **Traditional interpretation**
     - **Lore**
     - **Examples**
     - Bottom footer strictly stating: *"Astrology is an interpretive tradition, not a prediction."*
   - **No emoji, synthetic gradient washes, or unrequested badges/features added.** Touch targets meet the 44px+ standard.
